title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
sourceTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
synopsis: A broken fellowship, a creature in the marshes, and ten thousand Uruks at the gate of an old fortress.

nodes.text: The hornblast at dawn is yours. You hold the keep until white riders break the line, and you sleep that night in a cold corner that feels like home.
You ride with Aragorn out of the gate and into a song the Mark will sing for a thousand years. Half of you comes back. All of it matters.
Frodo cannot, so you do. Up a long road that has no name yet, you carry the man who carries the ring, and nobody writes that part down for centuries.
